subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Webhook Testing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Webhook Testing usable.

hook.text: Your API sends a webhook to notify a partner system. The partner never receives it. Nobody tested delivery.

buildup.text: Webhooks push events to external URLs. Testing them requires verifying the call, payload, and retry logic.

discovery.text: Mock servers capture incoming webhook calls and verify the correct payload was sent at the right time.

twist.text: Webhook failures need retry logic. Testing must verify retries happen with exponential backoff.

climax.text: A mock server test confirms the webhook fires on order creation with correct data and retries on failure.

punchline.text: Test what you send, not just what you receive. Webhooks go outbound.

quiz.question: How are webhooks tested?
options: Using mock servers that capture and verify incoming calls
By asking the partner to check
